# Agentic-AI-for-CadQuery integration

Source: https://github.com/naturecodec-stack/Agentic-AI-for-CadQuery

Pinned revision: `702b90e0d26b630d7eba09f85d29bb446f6a1b96`.

The upstream README declares MIT. The downloaded snapshot and its original
README are retained under `upstream/`; `provenance.json` records file hashes.
Original reference Python is not imported or executed by the furniture app.
`app/engineering_upstream.py` extracts selected prompt constants as data.
The application adapts these agents to its own provider client, schema,
deterministic solid-CAD tools, validation and project/job lifecycle.
